notes:
Cambodia administrative level 0-3 boundaries (COD-AB) dataset version 01.  
  
This dataset is structured into 3 levels:  
- Admin 1: 25 nan  
- Admin 2: 197 nan  
- Admin 3: 1633 nan  
  
  
Dates associated with this dataset:  
- 31 October 2024: dataset reviewed for accuracy and completeness  
- 04 October 2018: valid for use by the humanitarian community  
- 01 January 2018: last edit to the dataset before publishing  
- 01 January 2018: boundaries created by the source  
  
Contributed by [OCHA Regional Office for Asia and the Pacific (ROAP)](https://data.humdata.org/organization/ocha-roap).  
Quality assured, configured, and published by [OCHA Field Information Services (FIS)](https://data.humdata.org/organization/ocha-fiss) and [HDX](https://data.humdata.org/organization/hdx).
